title: The loop never writes a config it cannot read, and repairs one it can't load
description: On a fixture install with a registry worker role of 8 accounts at concurrency 16 (128 allowed): the worker pool grows only to the profile schema's maximum of 100 and the config still loads; a pre-GY-3285 registry whose worker concurrency 16 meant a total upgrades to 2 per account (ceil(16/8)); a master.json holding 101 loop-minted profiles is repaired by the next cycle — the newest minted removed until it parses — which then completes; and a cycle step failing identically for 10 consecutive cycles raises a dashboard Needs you alert and an attention line naming the error, without the master session.

steps.name: pool ceiling, registry upgrade, config repair, step-failure alert
